@@ -238,10 +238,14 @@ config_zsh() {
 
 		# Tell Antigen that you're done.
 		antigen apply
+		
+		# To customize prompt, run `p10k configure` or edit ~/.p10k.zsh.
+		test -f ~/.p10k.zsh && source ~/.p10k.zsh
+
 	EOF
 
 	# powerline10k config
-	wget --directory-prefix=~ https://raw.github.com/wstein/setup/develop/config/.p10k.zsh
+	curl -fsSL https://raw.github.com/wstein/setup/develop/config/.p10k.zsh >~/.p10k.zsh
 
 	echo /usr/bin/zsh | sudo lchsh "$(whoami)"
 }
